dish: Wisconsin straight bourbon from heirloom red corn, tasted in the farmhouse
w: Third-generation Dane farm making grain-to-bottle Wisconsin straight bourbon from its own heirloom red corn, aged in old barns and tasted in the family farmhouse; profiled by the Cap Times and Destination Madison.

dish: Falafel pita and shawarma plates (the lime-green cart's brick-and-mortar)
w: The Library Mall falafel cart that grew a north-side restaurant — Best of Madison 2026 Mediterranean/Middle Eastern gold (Madison Magazine) and Isthmus readers' Mad Faves Middle Eastern pick.

dish: Signature maki and nigiri off the Capitol Square
w: Downtown sushi lounge that sweeps both reader polls — Best of Madison 2026 East Asian gold (Madison Magazine) and Isthmus readers' Mad Faves Japanese restaurant.

dish: Char-grilled Oakcrest burger from Knoche's steak trimmings, ground daily
w: West-side neighborhood tavern whose burger keeps topping Madison lists — Isthmus' survey of burger heroes, Doug Moe's Madison Magazine column (Chicago magazine called it the top of 'burger heaven'), and UpNorthNews readers' best bar food 2025.

dish: The nightly-changing dinner menu built from Vernon County's organic farms
w: Luke Zahm's Viroqua farm-to-table café (since 2013; 2017 James Beard Best Chef Midwest semifinalist; host of PBS's Wisconsin Foodie) — ~85% of its food from within 100 miles, the Driftless region's flagship table. A long day trip (~2 h).

dish: Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza and a Venetian spritz
w: Food Fight's Neapolitan bar on Atwood, built around chef Giovanni Novella's Torre del Greco recipes and a proper wood-fire oven — Isthmus likens it to an oceanside bistro near Naples; the Cap Times calls the crust as good as any in town.
